integrity: Conjectured numerical formula and previously computed small instances are credited to the cited authors. The claimed contribution is an independent all-parameter proof by spectral-curve ramification. No independent scientific audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: The already conjectured exact formula is proved here only for the non-product Schubert subfamily with one size-m parallel class and two singleton classes; generic complex symmetric data in the orthogonal-projector embedding, \(m\ge2\). Low-dimensional checker runs corroborate but do not prove the infinite result; real critical counts and the full two-index conjecture are not determined.
title: A hyperelliptic proof of the ED-degree formula for one-block rank-two Schubert varieties
